title: Section 2(f) RTI and a co-operative bank

scenes.dialogue: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. If a co-operative bank is not a public authority, can its member still get the bank's records under the R T I Act?
scenes.shown: Hi, I am Ravishankar from LawWorld. If a co-operative bank is not a public authority, can its member still get the bank's records under the RTI Act?

scenes.dialogue: Twenty sixth October, twenty twenty six: the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J B Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K Vinod Chandran ruled.
scenes.shown: 26 October 2026: the Supreme Court bench of Honourable Justice J.B. Pardiwala and Honourable Justice K. Vinod Chandran ruled.

scenes.dialogue: A member of a co-operative bank applied under the R T I Act to the Joint Registrar of Co-operative Societies, for two of his bank's documents.
scenes.shown: A member of a co-operative bank applied under the RTI Act to the Joint Registrar of Co-operative Societies, for two of his bank's documents.

scenes.dialogue: He wanted its building contract with a labour co-operative, and its last general body minutes. In round two, the Commissioner and the High Court upheld his right.
The bank argued it is not a public authority, and that the Registrar can access its documents only once he is satisfied an inquiry is needed.
Under Section Two f of the R T I Act, the Court held, information includes a private body's records that a public authority can access by law.
scenes.shown: Under Section 2(f) of the RTI Act, the Court held, information includes a private body's records that a public authority can access by law.

scenes.dialogue: That power cannot be fettered. Prior satisfaction is needed only to start an inquiry; without the documents, the Registrar cannot decide either way.
Section Eight did not help. There was no trade secret, the bid was over, and for a member, this is not personal information. An outsider stands differently.
scenes.shown: Section 8 did not help. There was no trade secret, the bid was over, and for a member, this is not personal information. An outsider stands differently.

scenes.dialogue: The appeals were dismissed. The Joint Registrar must call for both documents immediately, within two weeks at the latest, and supply them to the member.
